_comment: Attestation-failure cluster: the email fallback button is NOT an existing-user-only path (a new user on a device that cannot attest mints an account through it), so the label drops the 'Already have an account?' framing. Each translation is harvested from that locale's own auth.deviceSignInDenied/Failed clause, which sits directly above the button, so the sentence and the button read as one instruction. Input to _splice-fragments.mjs with --allow-overwrite auth.alreadyHaveAccount. Never edit the 20 dictionaries by hand.
